soilTypes.label: Coarse (Sand / Gravel)
soilTypes.description: High permeability — contaminants migrate more readily to groundwater

soilTypes.label: Fine (Silt / Clay)
soilTypes.description: Low permeability — contaminants tend to bind and migrate more slowly

Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs).description: Complex organic compounds from combustion, coal tar, and creosote. Common at former gas works, rail yards, and wood treatment sites.

BTEX & Petroleum VOCs.description: Benzene, Toluene, Ethylbenzene, and Xylenes — volatile compounds found in gasoline and petroleum products. High mobility and toxicity.

Metals & Metalloids.description: Inorganic contaminants including heavy metals. Found at mining sites, smelters, industrial operations, and some agricultural lands.

Chlorinated Compounds.description: Synthetic chlorinated chemicals used as solvents, pesticides, and industrial reagents. Persistent in soil and groundwater.

Other Organics & Emerging Contaminants.description: Includes legacy pesticides (DDT), industrial chemicals, PFAS compounds, and other regulated organic substances.

Generic Soil Standards (Parts 2–3).description: Generic human and ecological soil standards

contaminants.name: Anthracene
contaminants.description: A three-ring PAH found in coal tar and creosote. Less toxic than higher-ring PAHs.

contaminants.name: Benzo(a)pyrene
contaminants.description: A potent carcinogen and the most regulated PAH. Present in coal tar, creosote, and combustion products.

contaminants.name: Fluoranthene
contaminants.description: A four-ring PAH found in combustion emissions, coal tar, and petroleum. Less carcinogenic than benzo(a)pyrene.

contaminants.name: Naphthalene
contaminants.description: The simplest PAH, with relatively high mobility. Found in coal tar, petroleum, and combustion products.

contaminants.name: PCDDs/PCDFs (TCDD toxicity equivalents)
contaminants.description: Highly toxic chlorinated compounds formed during combustion and industrial processes. Persistent in the environment.

contaminants.name: Benzene
contaminants.description: A known human carcinogen and the most regulated BTEX compound. Found in gasoline and fuel products.

contaminants.name: Ethylbenzene
contaminants.description: A BTEX compound found in petroleum products. Can affect the liver and kidneys at elevated concentrations.

contaminants.name: Toluene
contaminants.description: A common solvent in petroleum products. Associated with neurological effects at high concentrations.

contaminants.name: Xylenes (Total)
contaminants.description: A group of isomeric BTEX compounds found in petroleum. Can cause neurological effects.

contaminants.name: Arsenic

contaminants.name: Barium
contaminants.description: A naturally occurring alkaline earth metal. Elevated at oil & gas facilities and industrial operations.

contaminants.name: Beryllium
contaminants.description: A toxic lightweight metal used in aerospace and electronics industries. A known human carcinogen.
